audience: subscription billing teams who manage customers and plans in Recurly

useCases.title: Review active subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions, for the whole site or one account, filtered by state. It opens a single subscription by id.

useCases.title: Look up an account and its invoices
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer account by id or code and lists its invoices.

useCases.title: Compare the plans you offer
useCases.text: The AI lists the subscription plans of the site, filtered by state, and compares them.

useCases.title: Cancel a subscription
useCases.text: The AI cancels a subscription at the end of the current term, or at the next bill date. This changes billing, so confirm first.

useCases.title: Pause or resume a subscription
useCases.text: The AI pauses a subscription for a number of billing cycles. Setting the remaining cycles to 0 ends an existing pause.
